interface.longDescription: Discover and control 35 released creative applications with typed DCC-MCP tools; route scoped application UI through project-owned DCC-CUA/ui-control. Released product identities: Autodesk 3ds Max, Adobe After Effects, Blender, Cinema 4D, ComfyUI, FreeCAD, GIMP, Godot Engine, SideFX Houdini, Adobe Illustrator, Foundry Katana, Krita, Foundry Mari, Marmoset Toolbag, Material Maker, Autodesk Maya, Autodesk MotionBuilder, Foundry Nuke, OpenSCAD, OpenUSD, Adobe Photoshop, Microsoft PowerPoint, Adobe Premiere Pro, RenderDoc, Vicon Shogun, Autodesk Flow Production Tracking, SketchUp, Adobe Substance 3D Designer, Adobe Substance 3D Painter, Tiled Map Editor, TouchDesigner, Unity Editor, Unreal Engine, Audiokinetic Wwise, ZBrush. Typed tools remain first; DCC-CUA and ui-control are one project-owned UI route.
defaultPrompt: Show the released DCC-MCP products I can route to.
